notes.title: Welcome! And some FAQs...
notes.content:
Hey all, and welcome. K Station is an adventure game of disappearing lives, that puts its characters through the prism of alternate universes, to see what makes them unhappy -- or happy -- when it's gone.

I've gotten a few common questions during playtesting and soon after release that I wanted to weigh in on...

[list]

[*][b]Do I really type in my commands?[/b] Oh my, yes.

[*][b]Mac and Linux?[/b] I'll be taking a hard look at bugs and sales on Windows before deciding whether to put out Mac and Linux versions. If I do move forward, I'd estimate release in mid-to-late July -- but to be honest, it all depends on how Windows does. I'll be doing my best to get the game out there!

[*][b]Soundtrack?[/b] No plans for releasing it separately, though it's not hard to get the soundtrack out of the game if you look through its files...dot dot dot...

[/list]

Hope you enjoy the game, and please weigh in with bugs and feedbacks in the Steam forums.

Thanks,
Yash (K Station developer)
